shared: Pile Heat on one or two pieces turn after turn, then cash it into big stats.
differ: What Heat does on its own: nothing until cards read it, fight-only Attack, or growth that cools.

takes.label: Heat buys keywords
takes.line: Heat unlocks Shield at 4, Cleave at 8, Swoop at 16; Ember-Belly burns your own board for Attack and comebacks.
takes.look_if: clear Heat goals and hurting your own board on purpose.

takes.label: Glass cannon, then harden
takes.line: Heat is fight-only Attack with no Health; each turn you Quench it into stats or push to 10 for +3/+3 each.
takes.look_if: to decide every turn: bank the Heat now, or keep heating.

takes.label: Cooling heat, stacked Reforges
takes.line: Heat grows a unit +1/+1 per Heat every turn, then cools; stack extra Reforges, or Ember-Slinger hurls your burns at the enemy.
takes.look_if: to ring one hot piece with neighbours, and fling burns at enemies.
